what_this_is: A write-once companion to the delivery pin receipt results/live_ab/HARNESS_PIN_SUCCESSOR_20260925_2009.json (commit c12e19f, sha256 3745631750c3913f40069185971be8b3c2bd44e4538ab2fdc07cbdc7773da101). It carries the runs of the delivery step that came BEFORE that receipt was written. Root 19:15 required these runs to be kept "in R" (reviews/sm8_superseding_receipt_interim_20260925_1920.md on origin/main). R was written without the pin tool option --runs-of-this-step, so its key runs_of_this_step_before_this_receipt reads "not given in this invocation". The tool writes a receipt only from a fresh run of every suite (--no-suites is refused under results/), so adding them to R itself would need another hour-long run of every suite. R is left byte-unchanged. This record carries the runs instead, with the original logs in one archive. Whether this suffices or R must be regenerated is root's decision.
